program:
PARAMS = {
    "w_tail": (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # clocked tail nfet W [um]
    "w_in":   (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # differential pair nfet W [um]
    "w_ln":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # latch nfet W [um]
    "w_lp":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # latch pfet W [um]
    "w_rst":  (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),  # reset pfet W [um]
    "w_on":   (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),   # output inverter nfet W [um]
    "w_op":   (3.0, 0.84, 12.0),  # output inverter pfet W [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # Tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], L)
    # Differential pair: vinp side drains to node ap (below latch node xm)
    n.M("M1", "ap", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "an", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    # Cross-coupled latch: xm discharges faster when vinp > vinn
    n.M("M3", "xm", "xp", "ap", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xp", "xm", "an", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xm", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xp", "xm", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    # Reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xm", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "ap", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "an", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    # Output inverters: outp = NOT(xm), outn = NOT(xp); both low in reset
    n.M("MO1", "outp", "xm", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_on"], L)
    n.M("MO2", "outp", "xm", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_op"], L)
    n.M("MO3", "outn", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_on"], L)
    n.M("MO4", "outn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_op"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cg = lambda w: 1.4e-15 * w          # gate cap per um width (L=0.15)
    cj = lambda w: 0.9e-15 * w          # drain junction+overlap per um
    c_x = (cj(p["w_ln"]) + cj(p["w_lp"]) + cj(p["w_rst"])
           + cg(p["w_ln"]) + cg(p["w_lp"]) + cg(p["w_on"]) + cg(p["w_op"]) + 2e-15)
    c_a = cj(p["w_in"]) + cj(p["w_rst"]) + 0.5 * cj(p["w_ln"]) + 1e-15
    c_tail = cj(p["w_tail"]) + 2 * 0.5 * cj(p["w_in"])
    c_clk = cg(p["w_tail"]) + 4 * cg(p["w_rst"])
    c_out = cl + cj(p["w_on"]) + cj(p["w_op"])

    # Pair operating point at start of evaluation (tail near ground)
    op_pair = lut.op("n", p["w_in"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_pair = op_pair["gm"]
    id_pair = op_pair["Id"]
    # integration phase: discharge c_a + c_x by ~Vthn
    t_int = (c_a + c_x) * 0.65 / max(id_pair, 1e-6)
    av = gm_pair * t_int / max(c_x, 1e-16)
    av = min(av, 30.0)
    # regeneration
    op_ln = lut.op("n", p["w_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_lp = lut.op("p", p["w_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = op_ln["gm"] + op_lp["gm"]
    tau = c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / 2 / (av * dv), 1.5))
    # output inverter delay
    op_on = lut.op("n", p["w_on"], L, 1.8, 0.9)
    t_inv = 0.7 * c_out * VDD / max(op_on["Id"], 1e-6) * 0.5
    t_clk = 15e-12
    delay = t_clk + t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 2 * c_a + c_tail + c_clk + c_out + 2 * (cg(p["w_on"]) + cg(p["w_op"])) * 0.3
    energy = c_sw * VDD ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
